# Liability

A debt or financial obligation. Includes mortgages, loans, credit cards, and cultural obligations (mahr, ketubah debt, lobola) that are priority debts in certain jurisdictions

Source: [`v3/liability.json`](../../v3/liability.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/liability.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this liability within the INHERIT document |
| `liabilityType` | one of `mortgage`, `personal_loan`, `credit_card`, `overdraft`, `student_loan`, `car_finance`, `hire_purchase`, `secured_loan`, `second_charge`, `logbook_loan`, `mahr`, `ketubah_debt`, `lobola`, `tax_liability`, `funeral_costs`, `care_fees`, `mezonot`, `other` | yes | The category of liability. Cultural and religious obligations are included because they are priority debts in their respective legal systems |
| `creditor` | `string` | | Name of the creditor, institution, or person to whom the debt is owed |
| `amount` | [Money](common/money.md) | yes | Outstanding balance of this liability in minor currency units |
| `securedAgainst` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a Property.id or Asset.id that this liability is secured against. Unsecured debts should omit this field |
| `chargeStatus` | one of `active`, `discharged`, `satisfied` | | Lifecycle state of the registered charge securing this liability. Only meaningful when securedAgainst is present. A discharged or satisfied charge no longer reduces the equity in the asset it was registered against |
| `settlementAmount` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Redemption or early-settlement figure to clear this liability, in minor currency units. May differ from amount — a PCP or hire-purchase settlement typically includes unpaid interest and fees, and a mortgage redemption may include an early-repayment charge. Where present this is the figure that nets against the secured asset's value |
| `chargeRegisteredDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the charge was registered against the secured property or asset |
| `chargeReference` | `string` | | Registry entry or agreement number identifying the charge — HM Land Registry charge entry, finance agreement number, or the equivalent in the jurisdiction of the secured asset |
| `monthlyPayment` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Regular monthly payment amount in minor currency units, if applicable |
| `interestRate` | `number` | | Annual interest rate as a percentage (e.g. 4.5 means 4.5% per annum). Zero for interest-free debts |
| `startDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the liability was incurred or the agreement began |
| `endDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the liability is expected to be repaid in full, if known |
| `accountReference` | `string` | | Account number, reference number, or policy number for this liability |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this liability. Use for payment protection insurance, disputes, or special arrangements |
| `visibility` | [Visibility](common/visibility.md) | | |
| `studentLoanInfo` | `object` | | Student loan plan details. All UK student loans (Plans 1, 2, 4, 5, and Postgraduate) are written off on death — the estate does not need to repay. Confirming this prevents executors from incorrectly paying the balance |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
